prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” agency — it depends on what you need. To point you to the right Maryland agency I need a few details. Quick questions:

- What are your goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, local SEO, ecommerce growth, PR, etc.)
- Industry or audience (B2B, B2C, healthcare, tech, nonprofit, retail)?
- Monthly budget range or project size?
- Do you need a full-service firm or a niche specialist (SEO, paid ads, creative, PR, web development)?
- Any preference for location (Baltimore, Annapolis, Bethesda, remote-friendly)?

How I can help
- Give a tailored top-5 list of Maryland agencies that match your needs (with specialties and links).
- Provide vetting questions and a comparison checklist.
- Draft an RFP or outreach message for you to send to agencies.

If you want a general head start, here’s how to choose a great agency right now
- Look for relevant case studies and measurable results for clients like you.
- Check recent client references and online reviews.
- Confirm they’ll own strategy plus tracking/analytics (not just execution).
- Ask about reporting cadence, KPIs, and who will be your day-to-day contact.
- Beware agencies that promise overnight wins; marketing takes testing and data.

Tell me the answers to those few questions and I’ll recommend the best Maryland agencies for your situation.
